summary: Antalpha Platform Holding Co filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, reporting the quarterly financial results of its publicly-traded subsidiary Aurelion Inc. (NASDAQ: AURE). The filing includes an earnings press release for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, detailing net asset value, operating income from gold appreciation, and the company's participation in the XAUE protocol for yield generation on tokenized gold. It also mentions the launch of an AI agent named Duncan.Aure. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is described; this is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer. Consequently, no deal terms are applicable.
